messages:
Samir: spinning up asia-south1 cluster (3 racks, H100s). planning perf validation + handoff. brief checklist below, please ack and add any gaps.

Priya: ack. can you confirm driver/kernel versions we should standardize on? last time we had a mismatch on rtx nodes. :grimacing:

Samir: target is nvidia-driver 535.104 + CUDA 12.2 on Ubuntu 22.04 kernel 6.1. We also need PCIe BIOS patch applied on rack-02.

Taylor: noted. will run the hardware checks and MIG partition sanity first. quick cmd snippets for the runbook:
```
# driver + cuda check
modinfo nvidia | grep -i version
/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc --version
# pci and firmware
lspci -vvv | grep -A3 -i nvidia
# nvlink status
nvidia-smi nvlink --status
```

Jess: for networking: validate MTU and large-page settings. iperf3 between two VMs and host: 10Gbps expected inter-rack, 100Gbps inside rack. also run ethtool counters.

Samir: baseline workload is our gen-13-small model (seq=1024, batch=8) and chat-medium (seq=512, batch=16). aim: single-request p95 latency < 120ms for gen-13-small and throughput ~3.5k tokens/s sustained per GPU for chat-medium.

Marcus: ran an initial smoke earlier today on rack-01 H100:
```
# perf snippets (smoke)
model: gen-13-small (FP16)
latency p50/p95: 42ms / 98ms
throughput (tokens/s): 3600
GPU util: 92%
mem util: 68%
driver: 535.104
CUDA: 12.2
kernel: 6.1.0-54
```
Marcus: note: one node showed occasional kernel OOM logs at high concurrency, capturing dmesg to /tmp/oom.log for triage.

Priya: good numbers. add these validation steps to runbook:
- kernel and driver safe list check (exact versions)
- nv_peer_mem / ib_uverbs present if using RDMA
- nvidia-cuda-gdb not required but keep symbol packages for debug
- run 1h soak with mixed requests via k6 script

Taylor: network perf results from rack-02 after firmware patch:
```
# iperf3 (rack02-hostA -> hostB)
[ID] Interval	Transfer	Bandwidth
[  5] 0.00-10.00 sec 11.2 GBytes 9.62 Gbits/sec
# intra-rack (hostA -> hostC via 100Gb)
99.1 Gbits/sec
```
Taylor: MTU 9000 enabled, jumbo frames verified.

Samir: outstanding blocker: one out of six nodes had older microcode, NIC offloads disabled by default, causing 40% perf drop under small-packet loads. action: update NIC firmware + enable tx-checksum and tso; will push via iLO job.

Jess: for automation, I added a validation helm chart that runs the following post-deploy:
- node-level checks (nvidia-smi, nvlink, pci ids)
- small-bench container (our perf binary) that reports tokens/s and latency to /metrics
- iperf3 pod that verifies cross-node BW
config: values.yaml has thresholds and required driver versions. link: http://confluence/internal/eng-infra/asia-south1-validation (draft)

Marcus: also ran kernel-driver compatibility tests: used the nvidia-drm stress harness for 30m, no hangs on 5/6 nodes, one node had the OOM above. Suspect misconfigured hugepages -> disabling hugepages fixed the OOM in the repro.

Priya: tests to mark PASS before handoff to SRE:
- all nodes pass smoke perf (>= baseline tokens/s AND p95 latency targets)
- iperf3 intra-rack >= 95Gbps, inter-rack >= 9.5Gbps
- no kernel OOMs in 1h soak
- driver/kernel versions match safe list
- observability metrics flowing into console (traces + token-level cost)

Samir: timeline: finish firmware + microcode updates by EOD, run full 1h soak overnight, review metrics tomorrow 09:30 UTC. If green, handoff doc + runbook to SRE for operational acceptance.

Taylor: I can own the overnight soak run and post logs to the thread. tagging @InfraBot to run the scheduled report. :white_check_mark:

InfraBot: Scheduled soak job created: job-id iau-20260320-01, will post summary to this thread when complete.

Jess: thanks — I'll update the helm chart thresholds based on Marcus's smoke numbers. planning to add an automatic rollback if p95 > 200ms.

Marcus: throwing a reminder to add the kernel cmdline we used that stabilized the OOM: `nomodeset hugepages=0` and the patched BIOS SMBIOS setting for PCIe link training.

Samir: perfect. once soak report is in and no regressions, I'll open the handoff ticket to SRE with checklist attached. :rocket:
